messages:
Zoe: Morning team 3: small kitchen mystery - the sparkling water keg is fizzy but the tap handle is loose and the can opener has gone missing. Anyone seen it?
Ben: I thought I left the can opener by the sink after lunch yesterday. Will check. The tap handle might just need the little screw tightened.
Carla: I brought a pocket multi-tool yesterday - maybe someone borrowed it for the screw. Noticed a note on the fridge about 'keg etiquette' but can't find the opener either.
Raj: I used the keg for the team standup drinks and the handle felt loose after a couple of pours. I tightened it with a wrench but it creaked.
z supply-bot: Supply alert: can opener inventory = 0. Suggested: replace can opener x1, keg tap screws x2. Order queued if confirmed. (/order-7890)
Ben: Found a rubber-handled can opener under the coffee tins. Label is worn off. Putting it on the hook by the spice rack now.
Zoe: Thanks Ben! Can we add a hook label - "CAN OPENER (COMMUNAL)" so it doesn't go on mystery adventures.
Carla: Also proposal: 'keg etiquette' card on the counter: 1) gentle tap only 2) if handle loose, tag "needs repair" on fridge 3) if you borrow tools, return to box. Thoughts?
Raj: LOVES the etiquette card. I'll draft a tiny sticker with steps and stick it near the tap.
lunchbot: Poll: Preferred replacement opener? 1) Sturdy metal (recommended) 2) Electric can opener 3) Manual but ergonomic. Vote now by replying 1/2/3.
Zoe: Vote: 1
Ben: Vote: 3 (I like manual but comfy grip)
Carla: Vote: 1
Raj: Vote: 1
supply-bot: Order placed: sturdy metal can opener x1, keg tap spare screws x3. ETA 4 business days (/order-7890-confirmation).
Zoe: Small ask: can we add a tiny sign for 'tap testing' - please test with a paper cup first to avoid spills on the counter. Thanks!
Carla: Also if anyone wants to join a weekly kitchen tidy rota, I can put a signup sheet. Two people per week, rotate.
Ben: I'll take week 2. Zoe week 1?
Zoe: Yep, happy to do week 1 mornings.
Raj: I'll handle a check on the keg handle after each refill for a month and report back in this thread.
Zoe: Awesome teamwork - crisis averted. Small victory GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/cheers-teamwork-3o6ZsYd0f (for morale)
